topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I stepped into the yard sale on a whim, the sun barely peeking through the heavy clouds, casting a muted light. Among the clutter, there it was—my old teddy bear, sitting forgotten on a dusty shelf. His fur, once soft and white, was now a dull, matted grey. The button eyes that used to sparkle with the promise of endless adventures now seemed to stare back with the weight of time. I hesitated, tracing the seams with a finger, remembering the way he fit perfectly in my childhood embrace. The crowd moved around me, voices blending into a distant murmur. I didn’t know how long I stood there, but eventually, I picked him up, tucking him under my arm, hoping to carry home a piece of what once was.
